G46 reading 9, settled while reading the absent lines (it applies G45 reading 12 and changes no rule): a concept by the helping side, addressed to the helped room, that offers help, calls for it, or says help is being given now ('Us people at the trans flag are trying to help ya!', 'Helping to try and gain some of it back') is the help at its hour. A concept that reports help as given before or as continuing ('we helped', 'we've been helping', 'thanks for helping'), or a report by the helped side or a third party of help under way, places the help only before the report (G45 reading 12). Where a post gives help already under way as the ground of its own request, the help comes first, as empiredidnothingwrong-029 was ruled. Checked against every A14 line already written (instantiate, restrict, add): no ruling changes. Under it serbia-054, seolhyun-044 and rickandmorty-046 show the order (absent rejects); minnesotavikings-054 and raocow-044 stay limits (raocow's first end is also in an edit, G45 reading 11)

A14 census rules, logged before the script is written or run (G46's order test): (1) each ruled line takes the class it was ruled under (instantiate, restrict, add-condition and add-step spec files), checked against its written decision and kind: the order by the hours, the thread, the reply chain or the post's words (O-S, O-X, O-U, S-O-*), the order named in words (M-S, M-U, S-M-*), the bound (BOUND, S-BOUND), one offer or not orderable (J, EL-J), not terms (NT, EL-NT), not help after the terms (NH, EL-NH), one end (ONE, EL-ONE), after the close (AFTER, EL-AFTER), particulars apart (P-G6; dragonquest-033, tagged PO, shows the order and is counted with the order rooms but marked); absent rejects are the order with an ungraded channel, absent particulars are other, absent accepts with kind none are limits. (2) The channel of the first help after the terms, from the class: the same room the terms were with (S, the mechanism's channel), a third room (X), or not named (U). (3) Tags: R on order lines (the first terms named from the room's record), NB on order lines whose help names an alliance, an exchange of help, joint work or the neighbour relation and not terms (for F-020's wider count), PO. (4) A room is counted in each class its lines show, then once by priority: order, bound, one offer, not terms, not help, one end, after the close, other, limit. (5) Shares: the order among rooms with an episode (the order or the bound), then with one-offer rooms added to the denominator; the order in words among order rooms, and with NB added, beside F-020's 63 of 127 (0.496); the channel among order lines and rooms; beside C2's 138 of 214 (0.645; null mean 0.591, p95 0.636), its 108 transitions in 44 rooms and the counterexample response's 76 of 214. (6) Beside A13's census: A13's ruled lines whose reasons name A14 (held by A14, terms before help), counted by room. Lines exist where labelers saw both elements, so these are counts of ruled lines, not population rates
